info.title: Shrinath Prabhu — no public API
info.description: No API access is available. This is a public portfolio and blog, not an API service. There are no callable operations, authentication flows, API keys, or function-calling tools. The intentionally empty paths object records that absence; it does not represent a hidden or restricted API. Read public pages and articles using ordinary GET requests, optionally with Accept: text/markdown. See the site access guide for discovery links.
